en.t: Wouldn't that be quite all right too?

units.source_text: 有像北山杉那样的孩子固然可爱，可是没有啊。

en.t: A child like a Kitayama cedar would certainly be lovely, but there isn't one.

units.source_text: 即使有，一旦遇上什么事，很容易受骗上当。

en.t: Even if there were, once something happened, such a child would easily be deceived.

units.source_text: 就拿树来说吧，不管它是弯也罢，曲也罢，

en.t: Take trees, for example: whether one is bent or twisted,
as long as it grows into usable timber, that is enough...

units.source_text: 你瞧，这个窄院子里的那棵老枫树。”

en.t: Look at that old maple tree in this narrow garden.
